answer: Give each identity its own living terrace, a simulated plot seeded from its address where weather, pests and soil drift chaotically apart. One week the willow needs pruning, the next flooding, never the same schedule twice. A prism audit splits each record by its unique shocks: clones fed one shared playbook act wrong for most plots and wither in patterns that expose the farm, while bespoke care for hundreds of diverging plots costs real attention per clone. One honest keeper tends one terrace easily; multiplication demands genuinely separate judgment.
